summary: feat(settings): update Pair2 sync success illustration and download copy
description:
Because:

* The Pair2 sync success pages show an old illustration.
* The Download Firefox instruction has no final period.
* firefox.com/pair renders as plain text, because FtlMsg lacks elems.

This commit:

* Replaces the sync success SVG with the kit-devices-sync art.
* Sets the mobile image to 104px high and caps the desktop width.
* Adds the period and bumps the Fluent id to -v2.
* Passes b to FtlMsg in elems, so firefox.com/pair is bold.

Closes FXA-14420
